facts.fact: The African Disability Rights Yearbook report says an ongoing process of adopting a five-year National Strategy for the Inclusion and Participation of People with Disabilities, developed with the UN Country Team, which prioritises accessibility among its legal reforms.
facts.system: National Strategy for the Inclusion and Participation of People with Disabilities

facts.fact: The report says the 2012 Basic Law for Persons with Disabilities excludes accessibility among its rights, and that the Labour Code (Law 6/2019) has no specific provisions on accessibility measures.
facts.system: Basic Law for the Protection of People with Disabilities (Law 7/2012)

systems.system: National Strategy for the Inclusion and Participation of People with Disabilities
systems.owner: Government of STP with UN Country Team support
